subject: Follow-up: token profile, budget bands, and commitment options
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: token profile, budget bands, and commitment options

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can run accurate pricing scenarios for CatalystAI: 

- Token profile you mentioned: ~150M tokens/mo currently in test; target ramp to 600M tokens/mo over 9–12 months (peak bursts to ~1B tokens in promotional windows). Please confirm if the 600M number is the steady-state target or an aspirational 12-mo target.

- Budget range: you indicated a target of $X–$Y / month in year 1 during the call. For internal modeling we need an approximate target $/1M tokens (even a ballpark number helps). Is your procurement team targeting something like $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens, or should we be modeling at $1,200+?

- Commitment preference: we discussed a startup credit + committed-use discount. To qualify for the startup program we need company stage info (YC or seed/series A), total ARR (or ARR range), and whether you have startup credits with any other infra vendors. For committed discounts, helpful to know whether you prefer a 12-month vs 24-month term and whether multi-year billing (annual upfront) is possible.

Attached is a simple pricing scenarios workbook (catalyst_pricing_scenarios.xlsx) — I populated three bands: 0.5M / 50M / 600M monthly with suggested list/unit pricing and two committed tiers (12-month, 24-month). If you can confirm the steady-state ramp and a target $/1M token, we’ll tailor a formal quote and include startup-credit offsets and any multi-year incentives.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm steady-state target and preferred term (12 vs 24 mo) — reply inline
- If procurement needs to be involved, loop Jordan (cc’d) and we’ll provide a procurement checklist and sample SOW/MSA
- Tentative follow-up: 30-minute pricing review on Tuesday 11/23 at 10am PT — does that work?

Thanks — I’ll wait for those few datapoints and will update the mutual action plan (MAP) accordingly.

Best,
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: catalyst_pricing_scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 tabs: baseline, committed_tiers, example_unit_econ)
From: Samira Khan <samira@catalyst.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@catalyst.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom@catalyst.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T17:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token profile, budget bands, and commitment options

Alex —

Thanks for the recap and the workbook, that was helpful. Quick answers inline below: 

- Token target: 600M tokens/mo is our target for Q3–Q4 next year assuming feature rollout goes to GA; think of 600M as steady-state we want to model for pricing. The 1B bursts are marketing-driven and would be ok to treat as occasional overage.

- Budget / $ per 1M tokens: Our finance target is closer to $850 per 1M tokens initially, moving toward $650–700 with commitments and optimizations.

- Company stage: Seed-stage, raised $9M (Series Seed). We are in a post-seed hiring phase; would qualify for a startup program. We do not have current credits with other inference providers, but we have GCP credits for infra.

- Term: Prefer 12-month committed at first; open to a 24-month if the multi-year incentives are compelling and include predictable unit price floors. Annual billing preferred but our finance team can consider quarterly invoicing if needed.

Procurement contact is Jordan (cc’d). He’ll need a short procurement checklist and a sample MSA to run internally. Also, can you clarify whether the startup credit would be applied as a one-time invoice credit or spread across months?

Regards,
Samira
Head of Product | CatalystAI
samira@catalyst.ai | +1 (212) 555-0133
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira@catalyst.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@catalyst.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token profile, budget bands, and commitment options

Looping in a quick procurement + commercial note from our side.

- We can model 12-month committed tiers with an initial effective $/1M token target of $700 if CatalystAI signs for 12 months at 600M tokens/mo and agrees to annual billing upfront.
- Alternate: 12-month with quarterly billing carries a lightly higher effective unit of ~$775/1M.
- Startup credit mechanics: we typically apply startup credits as a one-time invoice credit that reduces the first invoice(s) until credits are exhausted. However we can structure the credit as a monthly offset in the MAP if that's required for internal accounting — that requires approval from finance and will be documented in the MAP.

Action items for us: Alex, please draft a short MAP that lists: volumes, target unit economics, committed-term options, proposed credit application, and the procurement checklist + sample MSA link. I’ll review and flag any concessions.

Ben
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@catalyst.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token profile, budget bands, and commitment options

Samira / Jordan —

Appreciate the quick replies and the stage/ARR clarity — that confirms CatalystAI qualifies for the startup program. I’ve updated the MAP and attached the PDF (MAP_v1.pdf) with the first-pass commercial scenarios: 

- Scenario A (12-mo, annual upfront): 600M tokens/mo, effective $700 / 1M tokens, startup credit applied as a one-time invoice credit reducing first invoice by $45k (example).
- Scenario B (12-mo, quarterly billing): 600M tokens/mo, effective $775 / 1M tokens, credit applied as monthly offset for 6 months (requires finance approval).
- Scenario C (24-mo): tiered pricing with floor at $600 / 1M tokens after year 1, contingent on 24-mo commit and annual prepay.

Jordan — procurement checklist and a short sample MSA are linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (see Files tab). If you'd like, I can also start a DocuSign envelope for NDA/MSA prep — I included a placeholder link in related items.

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan: confirm whether Catalyst prefers annual upfront or quarterly billing for internal approval
- Samira: confirm Scenario preference (A/B/C) and we'll produce a formal quote + draft DocuSign packet
- Schedule: I’ll hold Tue 11/23 10am PT for a 30-minute pricing review; if that still works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — attaching MAP_v1.pdf.

Best,
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan, 2 pages)
